artifacts.name: pocketbase-collections
artifacts.description: PocketBase collection schemas -- all tables, fields, indexes, and relations. Check this before writing migrations, hooks, or queries to match existing naming conventions and field types.

artifacts.name: pb-hooks
artifacts.description: PocketBase hook implementations (NN-feature.pb.js format). Shows all API endpoints, authentication patterns, and business logic. Check before adding new hooks to follow the execution order convention and auth patterns.

artifacts.name: wallet-api-spec
artifacts.description: Express.js wallet service implementation -- all wallet generation, minting, feeding, and blockchain interaction endpoints. Check before modifying wallet operations or adding new blockchain interactions.

artifacts.name: smart-contracts
artifacts.description: Solidity smart contracts (EggNFT, FoodNFT, AnimalNFT, Marketplace, TierBadge, CommissionDistribution). Check before any blockchain operations to understand contract interfaces, events, and state variables.

artifacts.name: deployment-configs
artifacts.description: Docker Compose deployment configuration for PocketBase. Shows container setup, volume mounts, and environment variables. Check before deployment changes or infrastructure modifications.

artifacts.name: nginx-config
artifacts.description: Nginx reverse proxy configuration for production deployment. Shows routing rules, SSL setup, and proxy headers. Check before modifying production routing or adding new services.

artifacts.name: frontend-architecture
artifacts.description: Next.js 16 frontend with App Router, shadcn/ui components, and PocketBase integration. Shows page structure, component patterns, and authentication flow. Check before adding new pages or modifying UI patterns.

artifacts.name: reference-implementation
artifacts.description: Reference MVP implementation with 20+ PocketBase hook examples in Thai. Use as template for new hook implementations and business logic patterns.

artifacts.name: production-deployment-guide
artifacts.description: Production deployment guide with SSH access, Docker commands, hook deployment workflow, and common error solutions. Check before any production deployment to avoid costly mistakes.

artifacts.name: contract-deployment-scripts
artifacts.description: Foundry deployment scripts for smart contracts (Deploy.s.sol, DeployEggNFT.s.sol, etc.). Shows deployment order, constructor arguments, and network configurations.
